title: AdS/CFT Correspondence
description: A theory of gravity in a curved space and a quantum field theory on its boundary, without gravity, are the same theory in two languages. The universe as a hologram, made exact.

puzzle.goal: Gravity in a three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space of radius L, with gravity's constant G, is the same as a two-dimensional conformal field theory whose central charge C counts its degrees of freedom. Write C.
puzzle.name: Brown-Henneaux relation
puzzle.ask: Find C for L = @{L} and G = 1 (in Planck units).
puzzle.method: The asymptotic symmetries of AdS₃ form two Virasoro algebras whose central charge comes out as 3L/2G.
